title_refine.style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

entities.evidence: Wikipedia entry confirms Bloomberg L.P. as the corporate entity; Bloomberg's own Chinese-language output and Chinese financial media consistently use 彭博.
Multiple independent outlets identify Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang; the transcript's 'Jensen Wang' is a transcription error for Jensen Huang. Chinese financial media standardly render him as 黄仁勋.
Jensen Huang is identified as Nvidia CEO in multiple sources; 英伟达 is the established Simplified Chinese name.
WSJ/Deloitte CFO Journal uses CFO for chief financial officer; Chinese financial media commonly keep the abbreviation CFO in titles.

terms.context: AI large language model billing and usage units
terms.sense: the basic unit of text processed by an LLM, used as the billing/consumption metric
the expense incurred per token consumed by AI models
the economics and governance of AI token consumption and cost

terms.context: corporate budgeting for AI token spend
terms.sense: a pre-set budget ceiling allocated for a category of spend

clip_research.source_claim: Token cost is the single thing keeping CFOs up at night, and companies manage it with a pre-set budget envelope, allocating the most tokens to engineers who can request more.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public 2025 surveys and WSJ/Deloitte reporting confirm AI token spend has become one of the largest incremental technology expenses and a top CFO concern, with finance chiefs struggling to track AI usage to avoid sticker shock.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript frames token cost as the single dominant CFO anxiety, while public reporting frames it as one of several major new cost categories; the 'single thing' framing is stronger than the documented consensus.

evidence.fact: CFOs are described as watching token cost closely and it comes up in every interview.
Companies set a budget envelope, give engineers the most tokens, and allow requests for more.

evidence.query: CFO AI token costs keeping CFOs up at night survey 2025
evidence.fact: 2025 survey: AI is one of the largest incremental technology expenses; half of leaders spend 21-50% of budget on it.

evidence.query: CFO AI token costs keeping CFOs up at night survey 2025
evidence.fact: CFOs struggle to track AI usage to avoid sticker shock as vendors charge by tokens.

evidence.query: Jensen Huang engineers spend tokens no limits quote
evidence.fact: Jensen Huang said a $500K engineer should consume at least $250K in tokens.

forbidden_claims: Token cost is the single largest CFO concern across all industries (public data shows it is one of several major new cost categories).
Jensen Huang said engineers should spend tokens with no limits (his public statement specifies a dollar threshold, not unlimited spend).
Chinese enterprises have a documented token-budgeting advantage over US firms (no comparative evidence found).

notes: Transcript 'Jensen Wang' is a transcription error; the referenced person is Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang (黄仁勋).
The clip is a Bloomberg Technology segment; Bloomberg is the publisher, not the opinion-holding actor, so no words_vs_actions or position_change is attributed to it.
Chinese-language sources on token budgeting exist but are mostly vendor/consultancy blogs, so term confidence is capped at medium where only one independent source supports the exa

winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
